Title: Log Analytics Agent for Linux 1.10 now available

Body.Content:
The Log Analytics Agent for Linux 1.10 is now available. This release contains stability and reliability improvements.

If you have installed the OMS agent for Linux by using Azure extensions and have automatic extension updates turn on, this update will be automatically applied in version 1.10.5. Otherwise, you can use the latest installer available in the agent GitHub repo, version 1.10.0-1. 

For more information, see the agent release notes.
